lead.headline: Gonzaga goes to Kansas State and wins by 40
lead.deck: The Zags beat Kansas State 101-61 as 15-point favorites. Oregon State is 8-0 and the model still isn't buying.
body: Gonzaga went to Kansas State as a 15-point favorite and won 101-61, the kind of night that makes the home team rethink its whole schedule. Massamba Diop had 18 points and seven rebounds, Isiah Harwell added 15, and the Zags covered the number by 25. Our model has Gonzaga sixth in the country, plus-28.0 points per 100 possessions, the best rating in the new Pac-12 by four and a half points.

The best record belongs to someone else. Oregon State is 8-0 after winning at Oregon 82-71, holding off Tulsa 69-66 and beating San Francisco 87-73. Winning at Oregon is a real result. The model still has the Beavers 70th nationally and fifth in this league, because the rest of the schedule has been soft. The power rankings moved them up one spot, to fifth. Undefeated, fifth, and a little annoyed about it.

Utah State is 5-0 and first in the power rankings for a second straight week, 19th nationally in the model. The Aggies beat Weber State 101-71 behind Will Hornseth's 22 points, and Mason Falslev went for 18, six rebounds and seven assists. SuperWest Sports reports the Aggies "want more." They get it this week: SMU tonight, at USC on Thursday, at New Mexico on Sunday.
Texas State is 7-0 and up to fourth in the power rankings after beating Incarnate Word 84-51 and McNeese 95-69. The Bobcats were 2-point favorites against McNeese and won by 26.

The league went 13-6 this week. The losses came where you'd expect them: San Diego State at Iowa State, Colorado State at Arizona, Washington State at Duke. Thanksgiving week is where the Pac-12 finds out how much of its record is real.

column.label: Look Ahead
column.title: Three road trips that will tell us something
body: **San Diego State at Maryland, Thursday, 1 p.m.** The Aztecs are 2-point favorites and our model makes it 3.5. They lost 81-68 at Iowa State on Tuesday, and Latrell Davis has scored 20 in both games this week. A road win steadies things.

**Utah State at USC, Thursday, 4:30 p.m.** The 19th-best team in the country by our numbers, on the road, with no line posted yet. Then New Mexico on Sunday. Two wins and the Aggies stop being a nice story and start being a seed.
**Gonzaga at Baylor, Thursday, 11:30 p.m.** Late tip, big stage. After what the Zags did at Kansas State, the bar for a surprise here is high.

notes.headline: Washington State lost at Duke and won the night
notes.body: The Cougars were 25-point underdogs at Duke and lost by four, 78-74. Lazerek Houston had 15 points there, after a 16-point, 11-rebound, nine-assist night in a 79-63 win at Hawai'i.

notes.headline: Colorado State's rough week
notes.body: The Rams lost 96-83 at Arizona and 84-81 at home to VCU, where Blake Harper scored 28. Carey Booth had 19 in both games. The Rams slipped from seventh to eighth in the power rankings.

notes.headline: Fresno State found a scorer
notes.body: Dragos Lungu had 23 points, six rebounds and five assists in an 80-68 win over Alabama State. The Bulldogs also lost 92-86 at San José State, where Mekhi Mason scored 30.

notes.headline: Circle it: San Diego State at Maryland
notes.body: Thursday, 1 p.m. ET on ESPN. Aztecs by 2, our model by 3.5, total 153.5.
